title: Curatom Polyglot rv0.4.0 — Owner-Controlled Capability Infrastructure for Machine Authorization
description: Curatom Polyglot rv0.4.0 is open-source DeepTech software by Yash Rajvansh and Comfort Curators Private Limited for owner-controlled machine authorization. Machines request narrowly scoped authority; operators approve or refuse it; authority is consumed before remote execution; and authenticated outcomes return to owner-scoped state. rv0.4.0 is a from-scratch implementation in the Curatom project lineage, not an in-place source upgrade of the earlier comfortcurators/Curatom codebase. The earlier repository remains the historical rv0.2.0 Zenodo artifact and later rv0.3.0 Google Cloud All Things Agentic hackathon submission state.
